lead:
**ಲೋಕಲ್‌ಪಲ್ಸ್** is a local-first ಈವೆಂಟ್ ಅನ್ವೇಷಣೆ ಮತ್ತು organiser platform ನಾನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದೆ ಜೊತೆ **Next.js 15 App ಮಾರ್ಗr**, React 18, ಪ್ರಕಾರScript, Tailwind CSS, ಮತ್ತು shadcn/ui. ನಾನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದೆ it in March 2026 — it's the most recent web ಯೋಜನೆ in ನನ್ನ portfolio. It uses local ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ storage as a zero-cost database backend alongside Firebase, ಮತ್ತು is built as a **Progressive Web App** ಜೊತೆ offline support ಮತ್ತು an install prompt.

ಲೋಕಲ್‌ಪಲ್ಸ್ demonstrates a full-stack ಪ್ರಕಾರScript application ಜೊತೆ authentication (Clerk), file-based routing, PDF ticket generation, calendar export (.ics), ಮತ್ತು an admin panel — all in a modern serverless-ready architecture. Code is on [ಗಿಟ್‌ಹಬ್](https://github.com/lingadevaru-hp/LocalPulse).

rows.ನಾನು ಅದನ್ನು ಏನು ಬಳಸಿದೆ: File-based routing, server ಮತ್ತು client components, layouts
ಘಟಕ library built on Radix UI primitives
End-to-end type safety — typed API routes, typed React components, typed Firebase calls
Sign in, sign up, profile, password reset — managed auth so I don't roll ನನ್ನ own
Zero-cost database — no backend server required
Install prompt, mobile icons, offline-capable pages

content.content:
**Event Discovery:** ನಾನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದೆ search ಮತ್ತು filter by city, category, ಮತ್ತು date. ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯd events section. Smart recommendations using category + city + rating affinity scoring. Access-controlled event visibility: local, college, department.

**Organiser Workflow:** Organiser verification via document upload (Aadhaar, PAN, GST, business docs). ಸ್ಥಿತಿ states: pending / approved / rejected. Admin review panel.

**Ticketing:** Downloadable PDF tickets named by event. Ticket history per user. Reminder toggles. Add-to-calendar export (.ics — Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar).

**Local Data Hub (/database):** Inspect all locally stored data, export backup JSON, import data on another device, clear all data. All of this runs without a server — the user's ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ is the database.

content.title: ಶೂನ್ಯ-ವೆಚ್ಚ ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪ ನನಗೆ ಏಕೆ ಮುಖ್ಯ
content.content: Using local ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ storage as the primary database means no database hosting costs. Firebase supplements this ಗಾಗಿ features requiring server-side persistence. The entire platform runs at near-zero cost — important when I'm shipping personal ಯೋಜನೆs without a budget.

rows.ಉದ್ದೇಶ: User ticket history ಮತ್ತು PDF download
Admin control panel — organiser approval, analytics
Local Data Hub — inspect, export, import, clear

content.content:
ಲೋಕಲ್‌ಪಲ್ಸ್ contrasts sharply ಜೊತೆ ನನ್ನ [[fraud-detection|ವಂಚನೆ ಪತ್ತೆ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ]] in approach: where fraud detection used a traditional server-side stack (ASP.NET, SQL Server), ಲೋಕಲ್‌ಪಲ್ಸ್ embraces the modern serverless React ecoವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ (Next.js App ಮಾರ್ಗr, Clerk managed auth, Firebase, edge deployment).

The ಯೋಜನೆ demonstrates ಪ್ರಕಾರScript across a full-stack application — type-safe API routes, typed React components, typed Firebase calls — rather than the JavaScript-without-types approach common in quick prototypes. It's the closest thing I have to a 'standard' full-stack web ಯೋಜನೆ, compared to ನನ್ನ blockchain ಮತ್ತು infrastructure work.
